key_insight: DPA4C-LR combines long-range electrostatics and electrical-response prediction with spatially decomposable machine-learning interatomic potentials.
engineering_relevance: The framework enables large-scale simulations of field-responsive materials, ion transport, and interfacial heat transfer toward device-relevant length scales.
method: Separate electrostatic forces and Born effective charges into global electrostatics and strictly local derivatives of learned latent charges.
Preserve distributed evaluation of energies, forces, stresses, and electrical response across different boundary conditions.
Implement DPA4C-LR on the nvalchemi platform and train on energies and forces.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports scaling to 5.2 million atoms on four GPUs at approximately twice the short-range backbone cost, inferred Born effective charges, and demonstrations spanning water infrared spectra, relaxor hysteresis, ionic conductivity, and Si/diamond thermal transport.
watch_item: The reported four-GPU scaling does not establish efficiency at larger GPU counts, where global electrostatics communication may become a bottleneck.
paper_title: Scalable long-range machine learning interatomic potentials with electrical response for atomistic material modeling
